name: worktree-only-write-scope
body: Law (prose; assessed by review): a code-writer's permission scope is worktree-rooted — no generated code-writer holds a write grant (edit glob or fs-tool path scope) that resolves to a main-checkout path. Distinct from `domain.constraint.fs-operation-scope-enforced` (the fs tools' runtime refusal): this law binds the GRANTS the agent-builder scaffolds, so main is unwritable through opencode's edit layer too.
